message.reasoning_content:
We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate every story for Minimal criterion. Need understand criterion: Syntactic, individual. User story contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to story sentence.

We have backlog 60 stories. Need judge each. Need consider if story sentence is minimal role-means-optional ends. Most are "As a user/admin, I want to ...". Some include "so that" rationale. That's allowed optional ends. Violation if extra info like comments, mock-up, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, etc. Need inspect all. Many have specificity like "using content identification or fingerprinting", "based on my profile", "by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags" means. These are means, not necessarily violation. Need avoid penalizing detailed means. The criterion says nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. So all standard "As a X, I want to Y [so that Z]" are minimal. But extra clauses? Example ZO-017: "I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest." Means maybe includes three capabilities? Minimal doesn't prohibit multiple means? User story contains nothing more than role, means, ends. Here no role? It says As a user, I want to walk around, access content using map and be informed if videos covering area... all are means? Could be a compound story but Minimal criterion not about atomic? It is about no extraneous info like implementation/testing hints. Need classify only Minimal.

Need examine each story text. Let's list all with possible issues.

ZO-001: "As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting." Role, means. No extra. No violation.

ZO-002: As user, I want search/discover music based on profile. No extra.

ZO-003: As user, search/discover based on other users similar. No.

ZO-004: "As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity." Means maybe OK.

ZO-005: "As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path." Role, means, rationale. OK.

ZO-006: "As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps." Has "for all further processing steps" maybe implementation/procedural? It is rationale/end? Hmm. It says "and have tags available for all further processing steps" - could be extra implementation hint? But the story is user goal: upload tagged videos; tags available for further processing. Could be normal result. Is "for all further processing steps" procedural note? Probably not, but edge. Need decide. Minimal violation if core story includes procedural notes. "for all further processing steps" indicates downstream processing, maybe implementation detail. But in user story, "so that" not present, but "for all further processing steps" can be rationale/end. The user wants tags available for further processing steps. Could be legitimate end. I'd say No Violation.

ZO-007: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments. OK.

ZO-008: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments. OK.

ZO-009: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments. OK.

ZO-010: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles. OK.

ZO-011: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area. OK.

ZO-012: As user, identify persons in videos, and receive related info about them. Two means; no extra.

ZO-013 products. OK.
ZO-014 broadcaster logos. OK.
ZO-015 brands. OK.

ZO-016: As user, take picture or upload image, so that recommended videos related. Role, means, rationale. OK.

ZO-017: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest. Role means, maybe multiple. No rationale? No extra. Minimal? Could be a run-on, but only syntactic minimal. It contains only role and means. No violation.

ZO-018: As user, search content items using automatic speech recognition. OK.

ZO-019: As admin, see, validate and edit segmentation of videos. OK.

ZO-020: As admin, annotate news video segments and extract topic for each segment. OK.

ZO-021: As admin, filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects. OK.

ZO-022: As admin, get quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before upload. OK.

ZO-023: As admin, prefilter nudity content. OK.

ZO-024: As admin, prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information. OK.
ZO-025: "As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement." Grammatically "validated" wrong but not minimal. OK.

ZO-026: As admin, prefilter content using search on high-level asset info such as metadata and tags either recognized by system of provided by user. Has typo "of provided" maybe. Means. No extra. Possibly "either recognized by system or provided by user" is elaboration of asset information, not implementation? It's detail but could be means. Minimal? Could be considered nothing more than means (with details). No violation.

ZO-027: "As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk." Means with sources. OK.

ZO-028: As admin, detect when scientist should be prompted to look at subject, based on annotations and info from Talk comments. OK.

ZO-029: As admin, identify volunteer types. OK.

ZO-030: preclassify Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features. Means. OK.

ZO-031: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them. OK.

ZO-032: perform automatic image series detection for case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images. Means. OK.

ZO-033: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti. OK.
ZO-034: animal attribute. OK.
ZO-035: animal number. OK.
ZO-036: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal. OK.
ZO-037: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton. OK.
ZO-038: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images. OK.
ZO-039: automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images. OK.
ZO-040: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab. Means + optional ends? "to reduce video duration" rationale. OK.
ZO-041: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg. OK.
ZO-042: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in satellite images. Means with examples. OK.
ZO-043: assess probability/weight of volunteer's classification based on their experience. OK.
ZO-044: perform prefiltering of images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors. Means with examples of artifacts. OK.
ZO-045: detect moving and transient objects in images. OK.
ZO-046: remove background noise and distracting sounds from audio files. OK.
ZO-047: group whale calls that are similar. OK.
ZO-048: identify number of whales heard in a single audio file. OK.
ZO-049: know when I should interrupt a volunteer. OK.
ZO-050: know whether I should interrupt volunteer with text, image, or video. Means. OK.
ZO-051: know when educate volunteer. OK.
ZO-052: whether educate with text, image, or video. OK.
ZO-053: "As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer." Missing space after comma typo not minimal. OK.
ZO-054: know when volunteer has made interesting comment on subject. OK.
ZO-055: know when Zoonibot should comment on subject. OK.
ZO-056: know when Zoonibot should give explanation. OK.
ZO-057: know what Zoonibot should say to volunteer. OK.
ZO-058: group subjects by similarity. OK.
ZO-059: recommend different projects to volunteers based on previous experiences. OK.
ZO-060: "As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them." Role, means, rationale. OK.

Need ensure if any story violates Minimal. The criterion specifically violations for comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other info external. Backlog seems all standard user stories. But maybe ZO-005 has "so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path" rationale. Allowed. ZO-016 maybe "so that I am recommended..." allowed. ZO-040 "to reduce video duration" allowed. ZO-060 "so that I reuse them" allowed.

Potential issue: Some stories include "automatic" or "using content identification or fingerprinting", "low-level image features" etc. Are these implementation hints? The definition says nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Means can include the intended functionality. "Using automatic speech recognition" is means. "using simple low-level image features" perhaps implementation detail? But it describes what the system does; maybe still means? Need operational decision: "core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to the story sentence."
